## Highlights

Labradorite Space 2026.1.0 brings a quieter workspace, a Library of vault files
and richer editing to the local Markdown notebook. Notes remain plain files in
the same vault format.

## Workspace and appearance

- **Optional Notes:** the plugin shell provides a keyboard-accessible switcher,
  shared settings and command palette. Notes can be disabled without removing
  its files; the Library remains available.
- **Library:** browse and filter every visible vault file, open Markdown in
  Notes, and download attachments or other files.
- **Light, Dark and System:** System follows the operating system and changes
  live. Earlier saved palettes fall back to Light or Dark.
- **Navigation:** a calmer title row, inline editing of the note name, compact
  menus, and a Format panel with keyboard navigation. The rail remains
  reachable with the notes panel closed, and Notes has phone layouts.

## Writing and embeds

- **More Format controls:** insert footnotes, inline and display formulas,
  Mermaid diagrams and callouts; indent or outdent list items; toggle a fenced
  code block; insert a rule or hard line break. The panel also opens the
  attachment picker, Properties, Save now, Find and replace, and note history.
- **Properties:** reopen typed fields or raw front matter without rewriting
  existing values, comments or spacing. Missing properties can be initialized
  from the panel.
- **Local embeds in Write:** view note, heading, block, image, PDF, audio and
  video embeds in the document. Allowlisted HTML also renders in Write;
  editing HTML source still uses Markdown view.
- **PDF, audio and video attachments:** save files in the vault and insert
  their embeds through the picker or supported paste/drop workflows.
- **Web and YouTube embeds:** external content is off by default. Permission
  belongs to each vault, and every embed still waits for its own Load action.
  Editing a loaded URL unloads it and requires Load again.
- **Embed source editing:** change an embed's target and label in Write,
  including note headings and local file targets. Cancel preserves the
  original source, and undo restores the previous value.

## Reliability

Shift-arrow selections survive focus restoration before formatting, including
whole Unicode graphemes and selections across inline formatting. Editor controls
keep their own text selections. Saves, recoverable drafts, revision conflicts,
late attachment uploads and links between vault files have additional
regression coverage.

Opening a note or switching views does not rewrite it. Untouched Markdown,
front matter and supported embed sources retain their original text. Markdown
view remains available for syntax or layouts that Write cannot safely edit.
Tables still have basic insertion and cell editing; this release does not add
a complete table-structure editing panel.

## Downloads and upgrading

This release targets **Linux amd64 and Linux arm64**. Each `.tar.gz` archive
contains the executable, guide, license and third-party notices. Verify the
archive against `SHA256SUMS`. No Windows archive is included in this release.

Stop Labradorite, replace the executable and restart it. Existing plain
Markdown vaults need no conversion; notes, attachments, trash and history remain
in their current locations. No account, cloud service or runtime package
installation is required. Web embeds contact external services only when
enabled and explicitly loaded.

Labradorite is intended for a computer used by one person. Keep backups of
important notes. ARM desktop/browser behavior and real default-browser
associations still benefit from a check on the machine where the app will run.
